formulas.name: FORM_Preliminary_TrophonChecklist
formulas.expression:
"Preliminary

" + "Operating environment meets specs: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Operating_environment_meets_specs}, {!Operating_environment_meets_specs}) + "
" + "Run self test: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Run_self_test}, {!Run_self_test}) + "

" + "Inspection and Cleaning

" + "Inspect for any internal or external chemical leakage: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Inspect_for_any_internal_or_external_chemical_leakage}, {!Inspect_for_any_internal_or_external_chemical_leakage}) + "
" + "Inspect tubing for kinks anchoring issues and leakage: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Inspect_tubing_for_kinks_anchoring_issues_and_leakage}, {!Inspect_tubing_for_kinks_anchoring_issues_and_leakage}) + "
" + "Inspect all board and cable connections: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Inspect_all_board_and_cable_connections}, {!Inspect_all_board_and_cable_connections}) + "
" + "Inspect chamber door locking mechanism: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Inspect_chamber_door_locking_mechanism}, {!Inspect_chamber_door_locking_mechanism}) + "
" + "Verify chamber door and handle functions correctly: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Verify_chamber_door_and_handle_functions_correctly}, {!Verify_chamber_door_and_handle_functions_correctly}) + "
" + "Clean the waste tray and exterior panels: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Clean_the_waste_tray_and_exterior_panels}, {!Clean_the_waste_tray_and_exterior_panels}) + "
" + "Inspect chamber seal, probe clamp, Gland seal, loom sheath: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Inspect_chamber_seal_Probe_clamp_and_Gland_seal_loom_sheath}, {!Inspect_chamber_seal_Probe_clamp_and_Gland_seal_loom_sheath}) + "
" + "Inspect and clean the chamber air path, if needed : " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Inspect_and_clean_if_needed_the_chamber_air_path}, {!Inspect_and_clean_if_needed_the_chamber_air_path}) + "

" + "Verification

" + "Run disinfection cycle and verify test indicator: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Run_disinfection_cycle_and_verify_test_indicator}, {!Run_disinfection_cycle_and_verify_test_indicator}) + "
" + "Verify printer functionality: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Verify_printer_functionality}, {!Verify_printer_functionality}) + "
" + "Reset PM Date: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Reset_PM_date}, {!Reset_PM_date}) + "

" + "Comments
" + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_1_of_Preliminary_Comments_and_Findings}, {!Preliminary_Comments_and_Findings})
